title: Rudy Morales III to Become Laredo Municipal Court Place 1 Judge
excerpt: The Laredo City Council unanimously approved Rudy Morales III as the next Laredo Municipal Court Place 1 judge, succeeding Judge Jesus “Chuy” Dominguez, who is retiring after 17 years on the bench, according to KGNS.
content:
The Laredo City Council unanimously approved Rudy Morales III as the next Laredo Municipal Court Place 1 judge, succeeding Judge Jesus “Chuy” Dominguez, who announced his retirement earlier this year after 17 years as a municipal court judge, according to KGNS.

The council voted on the appointment Nov. 12, KGNS reported. Morales is set to take the bench in January.

Morales, a longtime Laredo attorney, served as an assistant city attorney for the City of Laredo and was appointed by the council to represent it on the Laredo Independent School District Board of Trustees, according to KGNS.

“It's a real privilege, and I'm excited to go in and help run the court, make the court more efficient, and I look forward to it,” Morales told KGNS. He said he plans to focus on making the court more efficient.

The council also confirmed the appointment of Luis Cavazos as judge for Municipal Court Place 2, KGNS reported.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 13, 2026.
